preserveSays.line: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture: "If we rotate the watch, nobody pulls two nights running. Fair's fair."
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 10 people, 3 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
🍽️ Victor carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 50s: "Good. I'll take the first rotation. Somebody has to."
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture: "Good. I'll take the first rotation. Somebody has to."

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Leaf litter, birdcall, the smell of rot becoming soil. The woods, being the woods.
👁 Wary. Ears always tracking. Get close before it knows you're there.

Edible but lean. The old taboo itches; hunger doesn't care. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.

One mouse is a snack. Fifty mice is a meal. Do the math. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.

Nothing edible. (the humming in the grass (carcass), unknown shoots, unknown nuts, Hickory Nuts (in shell) — not food yet: A carcass. Clean it with a knife — quickly. Spoils fast..)

🌙 The night shift is out: a dog-shaped silence at the treeline and The Glow Stag. They own the dark — the cast turns over after sunset, and every step is riskier. A lit fire is a beacon — light through canvas, smoke on the wind. Sealed and dark, you're just a smell in the night. Haven's walls end every argument.
"So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.

Victor looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.

🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile west caught a Gray Squirrel! About 350 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
Nothing edible. (Gray Squirrel (trapped) — not food yet: Gut it quickly — clean with a knife. Spoils in ~2 days..)
"Earned, not given. You did the work — we just wrote it down."
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.

🔥 The fire settles. Mia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Tom asks "So it bleeds." Joshua says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Kathleen leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about The Living Wire. Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Get OUT of the water — When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek.
🍽️ Cheyenne weighs the day's basket against the pantry shelves and puts it down. "Enough. Carving bowls instead — we're down to the cracked ones."
(480 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)

◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.
🍲 Cheyenne cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Cheyenne worked the smoke racks too — 6 batches preserved (~3187 kcal, keeps a couple of weeks).
🍲 Cheyenne cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Cheyenne worked the smoke racks too — 2 batches preserved (~182 kcal, keeps for weeks).
Investigate and the morning is gone — tracking them costs a full day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing. Your call.
🍽️ Cheyenne taps the pantry's fullest jar. "More than we can eat before it turns. Rendering fat instead — the lamps won't fill themselves."
📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 2). Cold smoking (under 90°F) preserves without cooking. Jerky done right lasts months.
🌟 JACKPOT: A stranger by the road knows things. They talk for an hour. You learn: Food Preservation, Stone & Masonry. Your Codex overflows.
🍲 Cheyenne cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Cheyenne worked the smoke racks too — 3 batches preserved (~2388 kcal, keeps for weeks).
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.

(277 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
